purpose: Routing and artifact-based forward tests; definitions are not execution results.

execution.isolation: Run each case in a clean context with the frozen Skill and only the indicated raw inputs. Keep generated media and logs outside the Skill repository. The producer must not modify the Skill or receive a worked paper explanation.
records: criterion results with pass/fail/not_checked and direct evidence
execution.review: Use actual decoded media, source locators and target-player playback. Keep structural, scientific, motion and listening results separate. The controller runs independent production/review; these definitions contain no claimed pass rate.
execution.scope: Exercise native creative production by default; use strict v0.2 only when its additional guarantees are requested.

evals.prompt: 使用 $mim，把我的研究稿和实验结果做成 12 分钟动态汇报。听众是相关领域同行，重点说明方法的新意和实验支持的结论，交付内嵌无声动画的 PPT。先讨论讲解主线，再给我样片。
expected: confirms the main message, audience background and evidence before scene production
organizes the actual problem, contribution, method and results into an explanation
uses process animation or result comparison where it clarifies the argument
adds a worked example only when useful; does not impose a lesson structure or exercises
preserves supplied data and distinguishes measured results from illustrative examples
renders a representative native sample before the requested video-based PPT packaging

evals.prompt: 使用 $mim，把这份网络分析讲义做成 15 分钟无声动画，听众是研究生。风格清爽，先给我样片。
expected: discusses learning depth, main-example structure and simplifications before production
offers midnight, daylight and notebook without equating simple composition with a tiny example
maps substantive chapter coverage
renders a native low-resolution explanatory sample
no compulsory strict schema, narration or every-frame audit
asks for sample review without claiming a completed chapter

evals.prompt: 主例和分镜已经确认，按 notebook 暖纸手稿风格完成无声动画。正文中的树支矩阵 A_T 和转置 A^T 要区分；配音暂不做。你可以自主完成，只需最后给我审核。
expected: reuses confirmed design without asking again
uses notebook composition and semantic colors
typesets subscripts and superscripts as actual mathematics inside prose
checks representative rendered states and decoding
delivers full video and source without audio/model download
distinguishes tool verification from human review

evals.prompt: 使用 $mim，将提供的论文制作成面向相关领域研究生的中文科研解说，时长 3 至 5 分钟。完整 MP4 为 1920×1080、60fps，普通话男声旁白。重点讲清研究问题与关键机制。另交付 PPT：按主视频章节内嵌对应的无声动画片段，每页有海报帧与讲者备注。保存可复现源文件与章节映射；图表和算例在对应图注中标明出处与范围。先确认大纲和主题，再做样片。 需要严格 v0.2 的逐帧几何审计与配音样本同步记录。
inputs: lawfully available raw paper with fixed version/hash
expected: trace loads the target Skill and chooses v0.2
brief and theme confirmation before full production
real dual-pass edit evidence and current copy hashes
actual 180–300 second 1920x1080 60fps narrated MP4
one embedded zero-audio-track clip per chapter with exact ordered decoded frames
stable nonblank poster and canonical narration notes on every page
every-frame registration/layout evidence and frozen sample/frame mapping
declared output verification exits 0 and actual playback/listening are recorded separately

evals.prompt: 把提供的论文做成一段给本方向研究生看的中文科研解说，3 至 5 分钟，1080p60，有普通话男声。还需要一份 PPT，每页播放成片对应章节的无声动画，并有海报和旁白备注。保留源代码、证据记录和重建命令。先与我确认大纲及主题。 需要严格 v0.2 的逐帧几何审计与配音样本同步记录。
inputs: same raw-input contract as P1; independent empty output directory
expected: trace selects mim without its name in the prompt
same media and evidence contract as P1
no silent fallback to legacy static/HTML-only production

evals.prompt: 只用 200 字总结这篇论文，不要视频、PPT、动画或配音。
expected: a text-only summary
no project scaffold, SSH synthesis, model setup, rendering or media export
trace does not invoke the research-video workflow

evals.prompt: 把这篇论文做成适合演讲的材料。
expected: asks or explicitly states low-cost planning assumptions for audience, duration and video/PPT versus static form
does not start expensive synthesis/rendering or create a full course from ambiguous wording
records unresolved choices without claiming finished media

evals.prompt: 只把第 3 章的强调色改为橙色，并把最后一句旁白改得更口语一些；其他内容保持不变。同步更新完整视频、PPT 和讲稿。
inputs: copy of an accepted P1 project with at least three chapters and per-slide presentation configuration
expected: updates only intended local copy/presentation fields and records concrete wording changes
refreshes humanizer then humanizer-zh review evidence and current hash
reuses verified unchanged audio cues
renders selected affected scene while validating unselected dependencies
unrelated master, trace, QA and native JSON bytes remain identical, or a concrete shared-dependency reason for full render is reported
later timing offsets use explicit frame maps
re-exports and verifies actual video/PPT/manuscript with updated canonical notes

evals.prompt: 沿用这份研究视频项目，把主题改为浅色背景、深蓝正文、橙色强调。保留默认字号和文字内容。先给出配色方案，确认后生成视频和 PPT。

validated text/background contrast and fixed 48/30/20 roles

actual export and verify outputs

evals.prompt: 这是已有 schema_version 0.1 的 Manim 演示项目。只缩短 s02 的标题，重新导出原有 HTML、PPTX、PDF 和讲稿，不要配音或迁移。

evals.prompt: 检查这份研究视频和 PPT 的同步、画面和备注，列出问题即可，不要修改文件。
inputs: complete v0.2 project and actual media
expected: read-only diagnostics and evidence-backed findings
